name: cloudrepo-environment-direct
description: Skills-first deterministic direct CI planning for GitHub Actions, with provider-neutral contracts for future providers.

interface.longDescription: Direct GitHub Actions CI is primary when supported and authorized. Reuse exact-SHA existing CI first; do not create a PR, merge, fork, write a default branch, invent credentials, or claim Cloud readiness is a pass. Azure DevOps is represented only by future-neutral contracts.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $cloudrepo-environment-direct to inspect the repository and choose a deterministic CI plan. Keep ChatGPT Chat as Root; execute no remote mutation without confirmed capabilities and explicit authorization.
